sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • Built-in lightbox did not work in the Ticker layout — clicking a photo did nothing. Ticker slides now render the lightbox trigger just like the other layouts (when the built-in lightbox is enabled and the photo has no custom link), so a click opens the photo and lets you browse the whole gallery. Clicks on the duplicated slides (created for the seamless loop) map back to the correct original photo.
  • Per-collection boolean toggles ("Pause on hover", "Lightbox", "Show collection title") ignored an unchecked box and fell back to the global default. A native `false` meta is stored as an empty string, which the settings merge treated as "unset" and replaced with the global default — so turning a toggle off in a collection had no effect when the global default was on (most visibly, the ticker kept pausing on hover). These booleans are now stored as explicit `'1'`/`'0'` strings, so "off" survives the merge. Existing collections that were toggled off before this fix need to be re-saved once.
